subject.title: fix(gateway): stop health monitor from undoing crash-loop give-up

question: After the retry-bound defect is fixed, should the canonical ChannelManager contract use this recovery-ownership abstraction or the narrower private restart-state API in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/104492?
rationale: Both open branches fix the same composition bug but establish different required interfaces and policy ownership; tests cannot decide the preferred long-term gateway API.

options.title: Use narrow private state
options.body: Adopt the sibling PR's `idle | backoff | gave-up` manager query and carry over this PR's stronger stop-timeout regression coverage.

options.title: Keep recovery ownership
options.body: Retain this richer abstraction only after correcting the threshold and explicitly approving the exported helper and retry constant.

recommendation.title: Use narrow private state
recommendation.body: Adopt the sibling PR's `idle | backoff | gave-up` manager query and carry over this PR's stronger stop-timeout regression coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent ownership of the monitor and extracted health-policy surfaces makes this the best available decision owner.
